LESSON: CREATIVE WRITING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: WRITING
Topic 4.4: Creative writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Creative writing
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. write clearly with a variety  Learners give feedback on their in sentence structure, classmate's writing length, and pattern  Learners practice sequencing
2. use appropriate connecting sentences to form creative texts in words to sequence pairs and groups sentences  Learners are provided with

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Creative writing

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Creative writing

Teach
• Focus skill: write clearly with a variety  Learners give feedback on their in sentence structure, classmate's writing length, and pattern  Learners practice sequencing.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Creative writing.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Creative writing
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
